_doc: Metric labels, units, decimals and help text, shared by the Python solver and the web app (term = the Learn-tab glossary entry). corner = per-corner metrics, car = whole-car balance.

camber.label: Static camber
camber.help: Wheel lean at ride height. Negative = top leans in. Sets static grip; tune with static camber shims.

toe.label: Static toe (+ = in)
toe.help: Static toe. + = toe-in. Front usually slight toe-out, rear slight toe-in.

caster.label: Caster
caster.help: Kingpin tilt seen from the side. More caster = more self-centring and camber gain while steering, heavier steering.

kpi.label: KPI
kpi.help: Kingpin inclination seen from the front. Drives scrub radius and steering-induced camber/jacking.

scrub.label: Scrub radius
scrub.help: Distance from the steering axis ground point to the contact patch (+ = axis meets ground inboard). Large = kickback and heavy steering.

trail.label: Mechanical trail
trail.help: Distance from the steering axis ground point to the contact patch along X. Gives self-centring torque.

roll_center.label: Roll center height
roll_center.help: Height of the roll center above ground. Higher = more load transfer through links, less body roll; big swings hurt consistency.

fvsa.label: Front-view swing arm
fvsa.help: Front-view swing arm length. Sets camber gain and where the roll center moves in heave.

camber_gain.label: Camber gain
camber_gain.help: How much camber changes per inch of bump. Controlled by front-view swing arm (FVSA): longer FVSA = less gain.

bump_steer.label: Bump steer (+ = in)
bump_steer.help: Toe change per inch of bump (+ = toe-in). Should be near 0. Fixed with tie-rod inboard/outboard heights.

bump_steer_max.label: Max |toe change|
bump_steer_max.help: Largest toe change anywhere in the sweep. Catches curved toe traces that a slope hides.

bump_steer_curve.label: Toe curvature (avg of ends, + = in)
bump_steer_curve.help: Curved (U-shaped) part of the toe trace: toe at full bump and full droop averaged. Comes from tie-rod LENGTH/angle (move trackrod_inboard.y); the slope part comes from tie-rod HEIGHT.

track_change.label: Track change
track_change.help: Sideways contact-patch movement over the sweep. Big = tire scrub and unpredictable grip.

antidive.label: Anti-dive
antidive.help: Share of braking weight transfer taken through the links at the front. 0 = all through springs.

antisquat.label: Anti-squat
antisquat.help: Share of acceleration weight transfer taken through the links at the rear.

antilift.label: Anti-lift
antilift.help: Rear equivalent of anti-dive: link share of braking transfer at the rear.

ackermann.label: Ackermann
ackermann.help: How closely the steering matches the true-turning-geometry angle split. 0 = parallel steer, 100 = full Ackermann.

clearance_min.label: Min link clearance
clearance_min.help: Smallest center-line distance between moving links (tie rod, pushrod, wishbone legs) over heave and steer.

rim_margin.label: Rim radial margin
rim_margin.help: Gap between the farthest hardpoint and the rim radius (radial only).

caliper_rim_margin.label: Caliper to rim barrel
caliper_rim_margin.help: Gap from the brake caliper's outer edge to the inside of the rim barrel.

misalign_max.label: Worst joint misalignment
misalign_max.help: The largest angle any rod end or spherical bearing tilts away from its bolt, over the whole travel and rack range. Compare with the catalog's misalignment limit; see the misalignment table.

misalign_margin.label: Joint misalignment margin
misalign_margin.help: Catalog misalignment limit minus the worst angle, for the joint closest to its limit. Below 0 that joint binds: use a high-misalignment rod end, add misalignment spacers, or turn its bracket (the table suggests the best bolt direction).

roll_camber.label: Roll camber (outer, to ground)
roll_camber.help: Camber change of the outer wheel relative to the GROUND per degree of body roll. 1.0 = wheel leans with the body (no compensation, e.g. equal parallel arms); 0 = wheel stays at static camber. More camber gain lowers it.

roll_camber_max.label: Outer camber to ground at max roll

rc_lat.label: Roll center lateral shift
rc_lat.help: How far the roll center moves sideways per degree of roll. Large values make the car's balance change through a corner.

rc_height_roll.label: Roll center height at max roll

rc_min.label: Lowest roll center over the travel

rc_max.label: Highest roll center over the travel

roll_max_deg.label: Body roll swept in the roll check

roll_steer.label: Roll steer (outer, + = in)
roll_steer.help: Toe change of the outer wheel per degree of roll (+ = toe-in). Mostly bump steer seen through roll.

turn_radius.label: Turning radius (outer front wheel)
turn_radius.help: Path radius of the outer front wheel at full rack travel (kinematic, no slip). Must fit the tightest hairpin.

steer_arm.label: Steering arm length
steer_arm.help: Distance from the tie-rod outer joint to the steering axis. Short arm = high rack force and sensitive steering.

motion_ratio.label: Motion ratio (damper/wheel)
motion_ratio.help: Damper travel per unit wheel travel at ride height. Wheel rate = spring rate x MR^2.

wheel_rate_bump.label: Wheel rate at full bump
wheel_rate_bump.help: Spring (and bump stop) rate x motion ratio squared at full bump. Rises with a progressive motion ratio, a dual-rate spring or the bump stop.

wheel_rate_preload.label: Wheel rate with the preload term
wheel_rate_preload.help: dF/dz at ride height: spring rate x motion ratio squared plus the spring's static force x the motion ratio's change per mm. What a bench test measures; the usual wheel rate leaves the second term out.

bumpstop_travel.label: Wheel travel to the bump stop
bumpstop_travel.help: How far the wheel moves up from ride height before the bump stop touches (spring.bumpstop_gap is in damper mm).

ride_freq.label: Ride frequency
ride_freq.help: Natural frequency of the sprung corner on its springs and tire. Sets how stiff the car feels; FSAE cars often run 2.5-4.5 Hz.

aero_sag.label: Sag under downforce
aero_sag.help: How far the corner sinks under the aero load at your design speed.

ride_freq_aero.label: Ride frequency under downforce
ride_freq_aero.help: Ride frequency at the sagged position: it changes only through the motion ratio's progression.

c_crit_hop.label: Critical damping at the wheel (wheel hop)

damper_c_low_target.label: Damper rate for the low-speed target

damper_c_high_target.label: Damper rate for the high-speed target

damper_margin.label: Damper stroke left
damper_margin.help: Damper stroke left over after the full wheel travel.

damper_topout.label: Damper room to full extension (droop)
damper_topout.help: Room before the damper fully extends at full droop.

damper_bottomout.label: Damper room to full compression (bump)
damper_bottomout.help: Room before the damper fully compresses at full bump.

damper_static_pos.label: Damper compressed at ride height
damper_static_pos.help: How far into its stroke the damper sits at ride height. With symmetric bump/droop travel you want roughly 40-60 %.

trans_min.label: Worst rocker transmission angle
trans_min.help: Angle between the rod (or damper) and the rocker arm it acts on, worst case over travel. 90 deg = best leverage; below ~45 deg the rocker approaches a toggle and the motion ratio changes quickly.

link_clearance.label: Link clearance
link_clearance.help: Tightest center-line gap between moving links over travel and steer, against tube radii plus margin.

hs_plunge.label: Halfshaft plunge over travel
hs_plunge.help: How much the halfshaft length changes between the CV centers over bump, droop and roll. The inboard joint must slide this much.

hs_cv_in_max.label: Inboard CV angle, worst
hs_cv_in_max.help: Largest angle between the halfshaft and the diff output axis over the travel.

hs_cv_out_max.label: Outboard CV angle, worst
hs_cv_out_max.help: Largest angle between the halfshaft and the wheel's spin axis over the travel.

hs_clearance_margin.label: Halfshaft clearance margin
hs_clearance_margin.help: Tightest gap from the halfshaft to a link, minus what the tube sizes need.

arb_twist.label: Anti-roll bar twist per wheel travel
arb_twist.help: How far the bar arm turns per mm of wheel travel, from the drop-link geometry (the bar's own motion ratio).

arb_wheel_rate.label: Anti-roll bar rate at each wheel
arb_wheel_rate.help: Extra wheel rate the bar adds in roll: 2 x torsional stiffness x twist-per-mm squared.

arb_roll.label: Anti-roll bar roll stiffness
arb_roll.help: The bar's roll stiffness at the wheels for this axle, used by the car balance instead of the typed bar number.

arb_tau.label: Anti-roll bar shear stress at max roll
arb_tau.help: Torsional shear stress in the bar at sweep.roll_deg of body roll.

arb_fos.label: Anti-roll bar FOS (shear)
arb_fos.help: 0.577 x yield / shear stress at sweep.roll_deg of roll.

arb_progression.label: Anti-roll bar motion-ratio change
arb_progression.help: Change of the bar's twist-per-mm from full droop to full bump, relative to ride height.
